idea.title: Keep canonical meaning separate from platform variants
idea.summary: Aligning product and MVP documentation exposed why the shared canonical post draft and platform-specific outputs need distinct stages: Carousel structure belongs to Carousel adaptation, while LinkedIn remains a standalone variant.

context.goal: Make product documentation accurately describe the implemented Content OS lifecycle.
context.situation: Several docs retained language from a Carousel-first flow even though the workflow now writes canonical content before adapting approved platform and format variants.
context.problem: The old summaries could imply that the brief directly generates slides, every post becomes a Carousel, or structured Carousel content is the canonical source.
context.investigation: Compared the four requested docs with framework/workflow/Content Pipeline.md, which specifies Workflow 03 output as content/drafts/post.md and Workflow 04 as standalone approved variants.
context.decision: Document canonical writing separately from adaptation, and keep Carousel Content Model data specific to the approved Carousel variant.
context.implementation: Updated the product principles, product workflows, self-service Carousel MVP plan, and domain model without changing workflow implementation.
context.result: The four docs now describe canonical content before adaptation and distinguish Carousel-specific rendering data from other standalone variants.

learning_points: A canonical draft can preserve meaning and evidence while format variants own platform-specific presentation.
A Carousel MVP can remain narrowly scoped while fitting a broader post lifecycle.
Documentation summaries should be checked against the implemented workflow source of truth.
story_points: The detailed workflow had advanced, but summary tables and the MVP plan still reflected an earlier Carousel-first model.
The fix clarified stage ownership instead of changing the workflow implementation.
possible_angles: Why canonical content and platform adaptation need separate stages.
How to keep a format-specific MVP inside a format-neutral content lifecycle.
